mapper.select: SELECT ppe.id, ppe.patient_id, pep.prescription_name, pt.name as patient_name, pt.gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pt.birth_date, CURDATE()) as age, pt.birth_date, pt.medical_record_no as medical_record_number, pt.disease_type, pt.enrollment_institution, ppe.execution_institution, ppe.prescription_status, ppe.prescribing_doctor, ppe.created_time, ppe.updated_time FROM patient_prescribed_exercise ppe LEFT JOIN patient_exercise_prescription pep ON ppe.exercise_prescription_id = pep.id LEFT JOIN patient pt ON ppe.patient_id = pt.id WHERE ppe.id = #{id}
